QuestInfo.name: Carousel of Confusion
QuestInfo.0: Checky is passing out flyers in front of the merry-go-round. Go see what he's up to.
QuestInfo.1: #bDefeat the Canterbear#k causing a ruckus at #e#m223010200# near the merry-go-round#n.
QuestInfo.2: The Canterbear has been defeated, as Checky requested. Everything seems nice and quiet.

0.0: Hey, can I help you out? No photos...
0.1: Oh, hey, we've met in Edelstein, right? I, uh... I had to take a part-time job. Got some sweet new parts on order before I saw my paycheck... Actually, can you help me out?\r\n

yes.0: The monsters in this park are crazier than Bella. I didn't come prepared for that! I've been stuck on this dang merry-go-round for hours! How about you clear up about 200 of them so I can get to work?

no.0: If you're not going to help, I need to pass out these flyers.

yes.0: Now I can do my job in peace. Hey, you want to see my face? Too bad! Haha!

mob.0: Oh, man, I don't know how much more spinning I can take. Can you clear out about 200 monsters?
